notes: Substitute for Princeton. Princeton's floor plans are on a NetID-only SharePoint, and its hall pages give no room dimensions. The sheet's north arrow points left, so plan.png is rotated 90 degrees clockwise to put north up; plan-2.jpg is the original sheet. Double 507A pairs with 507B, which shares a vestibule and a single-use bathroom (one per four residents). Closets run along the full north wall behind bifold doors, about 0.6-0.7 m deep. Brick piers sit at both ends of the south (exterior) wall. The window is centered with a heating/AC unit below it (photo); its width (1.25 m) is an estimate and its heights are unknown. The entry-door gap measures about 0.80 m on the low-res sheet; it is probably a standard 0.86-0.91 m door. Furniture layout follows the official photo of 1009A: beds head-to-window along both long walls, desks with hutches mid-room, dressers near the door. All furniture sizes are generic estimates.
